label: s32_st_iris_the_wrong_photograph
title: Not For the Archive
summary: Iris away from the archive, and the audit's clearest gap: every one of her scenes happened in or about the room, which makes her the girl from the photograph rather than a person. Here she photographs something with no archival value whatsoever, badly, for reasons she will not state. Nothing in it touches the mystery and nothing in it may.
